newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares continue slide in sluggish market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares continue slide in sluggish market.

text.p: Egyptian share prices continued to slide on Monday despite some high turnover in some popular shares, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index closed 2.42 points lower at 375.99 from 378.41 on Sunday in average volume of 60.53 million pounds ($17.83 million).

"The market was a bit strange today. Prices were not up too much despite strong demand on some shares. It is mainly institutions and funds that are buying. They don't want the prices to go up too much," said Youssef Khalil of Delta/EAB.
Eipico/Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries was the day's most active share, inching up 0.5 pounds to 205.5 with shares worth 7.40 million pounds changing hands.
"There was a large volume on cement shares because their good prices have created strong demand," Khalil said.
Egyptian Tora Portland Cement again was the day's second most active share, closing 0.98 pounds higher at 97.98 after shares worth more than 6.00 million were traded.

The cement firm announced on Sunday that its net after-tax profits rose to 78.5 million pounds ($23 million) in the first half of the 1996/7 financial year from 63.45 million in the same period of the previous year.
Helwan Portland Cement HELW.CA also performed well, but ended unchanged at 78 pounds. Shares worth more than 3.80 million pounds were traded.
North Cairo Flour Mills was again the best performer in the popular milling sector. It ended trading unchanged at 190 with shares worth more than 4.60 million pounds being traded.
The index for openly traded firms fell to 564.39 points from 575.3 points on Sunday. The index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 264.71 from 264.46.
Out of the 78 shares traded on Monday, 28 gained, 30 lost and 20 ended unchanged.
